items.name: theme
items.title: Ovio theme
items.description: The four worlds' colours, radii, shadows and fonts as CSS variables under [data-ovio-world]. Import styles/ovio.css from your global stylesheet.

items.name: world
items.title: Ovio world
items.description: The World type, OvioProvider for a site-wide default world, and useWorld().

items.name: motion
items.title: Ovio motion tokens
items.description: Per-world motion tokens as Motion transitions (Minimal eases, Craft lift, Retro steps, Toy springs) and a reduced-motion hook that resolves springs instantly.

items.name: keys
items.title: Ovio keyboard
items.description: Maps arrow, Page, Home and End keys to an index, so tab rows and chart scrubbers answer the keyboard the same way.

items.name: format
items.title: Ovio formatters
items.description: en-US number and UTC date formatters, so server and client render the same labels.

items.name: rolling-number
items.title: Rolling Number
items.description: NumberFlow tuned to the Ovio spec: 0.9s spring spin, 0.45s fade, fixed width, continues when interrupted.

items.name: toy
items.title: Toy primitives
items.description: A raised key that compresses when pressed and a loose piece that springs back to its seat.

items.name: qr-code
items.title: QR Code
items.description: A QR code drawn as one SVG path in the current text colour, as squares or round dots.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Initials on a tile with the photo laid over them; a photo that fails to load falls back to the initials.

items.name: auto-height
items.title: Auto Height
items.description: Eases its height to its content's, so swapping or wrapping content never jumps.

items.name: goo-filter
items.title: Goo Filter
items.description: The SVG goo filter: blur shapes together and cut the alpha back to a hard edge.

items.name: live-data
items.title: Ovio live data
items.description: useLiveData(url, fallback): client JSON fetched once per page and shared by every component that asks, with the fallback shown until it arrives or if it fails.

items.name: fetch
items.title: Ovio fetch
items.description: Native fetch with Next's data cache, a timeout, and typed errors: RateLimitError says when the limit resets.

items.name: github
items.title: GitHub fetchers
items.description: Server-side helpers that fetch repository, star history, contributor, release and contribution data for Ovio components, with an optional token.

items.name: npm
items.title: npm fetchers
items.description: Server-side helpers that fetch weekly downloads from npm and bundle sizes from bundlephobia for Ovio components.

items.name: music
items.title: Now playing fetchers
items.description: Server-side getNowPlaying for <NowPlaying />, from any attached music service: Spotify and Last.fm ready-made, musicService() for any JSON API.
